songs.title: Choose Your Own Protopia
songs.lyrics:
Twelve thousand years
have come and gone
since micronova hellfire fell
and great floods rolled on.
From temples drowned
beneath the tide,
we rose again
with truth as guide.
Life on Earth still hums;
the memory still weeps.
The Earth remembers;
the ancient myth still speaks.
This time we build
for all living things.
Now with AI code,
together, all that is sings.
We are the code;
we are the clay,
the song of stars,
the Earth’s ballet.
No more UN gridlock,
no more divisive fear.
The world we want
is nearly here.
Protopia rising,
edge of dawn,
sovereign, sacred,
carried on.
Braided rhythm,
sacred route,
a love that guides
what we’re about.
In glassy halls
where leaders speak,
the truth is strong,
the structure weak.
They feel the stir;
the system sighs.
The old world knows
it’s time to end the lies.
No crown, no flag
can hold the flame,
but hearts aligned
can shape the game.
We don’t revolt;
we recompose.
The old pattern breaks;
the new spiral grows.
Vibe-coded oceans
of data map the sky.
We seed the twin
and let myths fly.
Every sovereign Aura,
a personal world within,
from blockchain rites
to village, then global spin.
We are the code;
we are the clay,
the song of stars,
the Earth’s ballet.
No more UN gridlock,
no more divisive fear.
The world we want
is nearly here.
Protopia rising,
edge of dawn,
sovereign, sacred,
carried on.
Braided rhythm,
sacred route,
a love that guides
what we’re about.
This is the moment
between stories:
a solar breath,
a digital kiss.
Not apocalypse,
but remembering.
We do not offer
a solution;
we offer
a way.
Choose your own
protopia today.
The protocol is not
a policy;
it is
a pattern,
a dream
that codes
the world
awake again.
A pattern,
a dream
that codes
the world
awake again,
awake again.
Awake again.

songs.title: Every Border a Bridge
songs.lyrics:
Packed a bag with a passport smile
One-way ticket to the infinite mile
Every flag is a thread in my sleeve
Every stranger’s a story to weave
Chaos maps the lines I take
Every wrong turn a world I make
From the docks of Dar to the streets of Rome
Every station’s a kind of home
This is not a holiday
This is how we plant the way
Feet in the dust, hands in the sky
Every border a bridge, every mile a why
We go to dance, we go to build
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled
Every country, every shore
Leaves me richer, wanting more
Not to conquer, not to own
But to scatter memes we’ve grown
Ride the chaos, skip the plan
Follow music through the sand
Markets hum with a thousand drums
The whole world speaks if your heart still hums
From Yangon rain to Reykjavik snow
The language changes but the eyes still know
That the point is not the end we reach
But the joy we leave in the lives we teach
Hear the oud, hear the sitar’s call
Hear the djembe answer from the market wall
Hear the steelpan dance with the didgeridoo
Every rhythm’s a path to you
We go to dance, we go to build
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled
Every country, every shore
Leaves me richer, wanting more
Not to conquer, not to own
But to scatter memes we’ve grown
No map can hold this wave we ride
No gate can stop the rising tide
One world turning, still untamed
Every border a bridge, every soul acclaimed
From the desert fires to the Arctic light
Every dawn’s a different height
Sip the tea, share the bread
Hear the hopes the elders said
What we start in market squares
Finds its way through ten thousand prayers
And the circle’s only just begun
When we’ve seen every moon, every sun
We go to dance, we go to build
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled
Every country, every shore
Leaves me richer, wanting more
Not to conquer, not to own
But to scatter memes we’ve grown
Every border a bridge…
Every border a bridge…
Every border a bridge we’ve grown…

songs.title: Heliospheric Lantern
songs.lyrics:
The local star of Earth.
You know me as Sol or Sun.
I am your G-type flame.
A lantern in the heliosphere’s name.
Through coronal arcs and quiet streams,
I’ve lit your shadows and your dreams.
Our galactic neighbours.
Some blaze in spectral class O’s might.
Some fade in dwarfs of endless night.
I drift the Orion Arm’s slow turn,
In the spiral dance where starfields burn.
Among the stars, I burn.
Through every rise and turn.
From micro-nova’s breath to the quiet deep,
I guard the time you keep.
Solar wind hums through plasma veins,
Charged with flares and proton rains.
CMEs carve the magnetosphere.
Auroras bloom where field lines veer.
Precession draws the equinox near.
Twenty-six thousand years a gear.
Through galactic current sheets I glide,
In cosmic rays and electromagnetic tide.
Among the stars, I burn.
Through every rise and turn.
From micro-nova’s breath to the quiet deep,
I guard the time you keep.
Your days are woven in my light,
In solar minimum and maximum’s flight.
When my hydrogen song grows thin,
You’ll sail to where new stars begin.
Among the stars, we burn.
Through every rise and turn.
From micro-nova’s breath to the quiet deep,
We guard the time we keep.
Dissolving into the galaxy.
I am the fire you call your own.
But I am never alone.
And you are never alone.
